name: Mech Tank
identity: Supplied cyber_tank_rigged.glb (licence unknown: local-only, git-ignored; clones without it draw the Tiger I mesh). An autonomous AI tank: no crew, no Enter prompt (AiType Mech Tank).

model.note: Turret_Yaw / Barrel_Pitch are the nodes the file's Turret_Traverse_360 / Barrel_Elevation clips rotate; the code drives them. 5.735 m long as supplied, scaled to 7.5 m (a heavy hull). animRootTravel: Drive_Forward carries the whole tank 7.859 m forward over its 5 s (measured on the bake); taken out at import, so one loop of the track / wheel clip = 7.859 m driven.

rig.note: measured on the bake: Turret_Yaw / Barrel_Pitch node origins (S 1.3098, re-origined), the muzzle at the barrel tip

colliders.note: boxes in hull space from the baked bounds (body 5.65 x 2.81 x 7.5 m, turret 3.2 x 1.04 x 3.4 m at the rear)

gun.name: 8.8 cm KwK 36 L/56
gun.note: rates, limits and sight field are provisional game tuning; the Sherman's faster traverse is the requested direction

ammunition.note: reserves and reload time are provisional game values

mobility.note: road top speed follows the museum listing (faster than the Firefly on roads); off-road multiplier, acceleration and turning make it feel heavier (gameplay tuning)

bowMg.name: MG 42 type bow MG (hull ball mount)
bowMg.note: ball mount measured on the supplied mesh (right of the driver, the radio operator's gun); the user asked for an MG 42 type gun with the MG 42 sound pack. 50-round belts change automatically (crew).

ramming.note: a notch above the Tiger: heavier, more power (game tuning)

mech.note: autonomous AI (tank_mech.cpp): holds this standoff to its target, sees this far, crushes low obstacles up to stepHeight (m) instead of stopping
